title: Research on Migrant Works' Concern Recognition and Emotion Analysis Based on Web Text Data.
summary: Web-text analysis identified wages, education, medical care, and return migration as migrant workers' main concerns. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: machine-learning web-text classification of migrant workers’ concerns

evidence.tested: Web-text analysis identified wages, education, medical care, and return migration as migrant workers' main concerns.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
